source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Legends rules are official, and you're encouraged to use them for home, store and club games and for campaigns. Legends points are updated less often than Codex points, so these units aren't recommended at competitive Warhammer Events unless the event organisers allow them.

Warhammer Legends units come in 2 kinds:

- Units dropped from your army's Codex that still get datasheets of their own and Legends points. Add them to your army like any other unit from your Codex, keeping in mind the advice on competitive events.
- **Legendary Proxies** units, which other datasheets in your Codex represent well. Use the datasheet this document names for each, with its points values, and field it like any other unit. During the mission sequence, make sure your opponent knows which unit each of your **Legendary Proxies** units stands for. Their size or base size can differ from those of the units they count as; when that causes an issue in battle, such as a **Legendary Proxies** unit being [visible](vsdata:core-rule/visibility) where the unit it stands for would not be, settle it in the other player's favour, as good practice.

issueResolution.advice: err in favour of the other player
